question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**Currying favour**
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Seeking approval through flattery. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Currying favour"** means seeking approval or advantage from someone through excessive flattery or trying to please them. (खुशामद करके पक्ष लेना) • **Example:** He was currying favour with his boss by always complimenting her ideas. • **Explanation of the correct option:** "Seeking approval through flattery" is the appropriate meaning of the idiom "currying favour." It represents the act of gaining someone’s favor by being overly pleasing or flattering. (खुशामद के माध्यम से स्वीकृति प्राप्त करना) • **Example:** The employee tried currying favour with the manager to secure a promotion. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Seeking emotional validation** (भावनात्मक मान्यता प्राप्त करना): The act of wanting confirmation or approval for one’s emotions or feelings. • **Example:** She constantly seeks emotional validation from her friends. • **Option 3: Avoiding direct confrontation** (प्रत्यक्ष टकराव से बचना): Refers to steering clear of any direct conflict or argument. • **Example:** Instead of addressing the issue, he avoided direct confrontation with his colleagues. • **Option 4: Asking for forgiveness subtly** (धीरे-धीरे माफी मांगना): Refers to apologizing in an indirect or subtle way. • **Example:** She asked for forgiveness subtly by leaving a heartfelt note on his desk. 38:T655, The correct answer is **option 1.**
